nodes.text: Let $r_3(N)$ be the size of the largest subset of $\{1,\ldots,N\}$ which does not contain a non-trivial $3$-term arithmetic progression. Prove that $r_3(N)\ll N/(\log N)^C$ for every $C>0$.

#140 : [ErGr80,p.11] [Er81] [Er97c] additive combinatorics | arithmetic progressions Proved by Kelley and Meka [KeMe23] . In [ErGr80] and [Er81] it is conjectured that this holds for every $k$-term arithmetic progression. See also [3] .
